description: Read tasks from a 'todo' board with server-side filtering — handy for 'what's overdue?' / 'what's assigned to X?' without pulling the whole board. All filters are optional and AND together: `assignee` (exact match), `priority` ('H'|'M'|'L'), `done` (boolean), `overdue` (true → due_date strictly before today, not done), `due_before` / `due_after` (ISO date window on due_date). Returns `{ boardId, mode, tasks }` — tasks ordered by sort, each with the same fields as `list_tasks`.

access_key.description: 8-character lowercase alphanumeric board access key when the board is locked (legacy 6-character lowercase alphanumeric keys are also accepted). Equivalent to setting the `X-Board-Key` HTTP header on the JSON-RPC POST. Omit for unlocked boards. Obtain via POST /api/boards/<id>/lock.

overdue.description: Only tasks past due and not done.
